meta.notes: Generated by reverse-engineering the live prototype's own theme file (src/tokens/ds/themes/fcm.css, itself sourced from a Figma tokens export per its header comment) and the system-constant token tiers (space.css, system.css) — NOT from reference imagery or a brand deck. Every value under codashop.brandLocked is cited to a specific CSS declaration and is meant to be machine-checked against that same file by tools/style-guide-check.mjs. The 'generic' block's brand-voice fields are intentionally omitted rather than fabricated. JSON-only deliverable; no guide.html was produced for this store.

primary.usage: brand green — CTA/action, primary ramp seed (anchored at ramp step 600, not 500)

neutral.usage: container colour (--x-ref-neutral); the page itself is pure black, --x-palette-neutral-1000

typePrimitives.weightsNote: Cruyff Sans ships only Regular/Medium/Bold cuts (no Semibold 600 or ExtraBold 800) — the DS weight tokens are remapped onto the 3 real cuts to avoid faux-bold synthesis. bold=500 (Medium) approximates Figma's Semibold; extraBold=700 (Bold) covers ExtraBold's role. See fcm.css:177-186 for the exact rationale.

typography.notes: Same mobile-only scale as every other store in this repo — no desktop tier exists in the codebase to derive.

generic._note: Fields set to null above require reference imagery or written brand guidance this session did not have access to. Do not backfill them with invented copy — regenerate from real source material instead.

codashop.architectureNote: Same 5-tier cascade as every store (see the codm spec.json for the full statement). FCM's distinguishing structural fact: -main overrides re-point primary/positive/negative onto their actual seed step (600/600/400) instead of the system default of 500, because FCM's Figma export anchors those seeds off-center in their ramps (fcm.css:164-170). SYSTEM CONSTANT tiers (layoutSystem, the radius/space/stroke/elevation scale, .text-style-* composition) are identical to every other store, COD:M included, EXCEPT --x-radius-control-full, which FCM overrides to the full pill step (999px) — see brandLocked.brandCharacter below.

layoutSystem.containerRule: device screen sets container-type:inline-size; overlay must NOT (traps position:fixed)
layoutSystem.note: System constant — identical for every store in this repo. Not re-derived per store; see docs/grid-layout-system.md for the authoritative breakpoint/grid table.

themePreset.name: EA SPORTS FC Mobile
themePreset.font: Cruyff Sans (heading + body — one face for both, unlike COD:M's split heading/body)
themePreset.borderRadius: control-full overridden to --x-sys-radius-full (999px, true pill) — the 2px system default is replaced repo-wide for this store (space.css :root default is 2px; see fcm.css:376-377)

palette.anchorRule: Off-system: primary/positive anchor at ramp step 600 (not 500), negative at step 400. secondary/tertiary/caution anchor at the system-default 500. --x-sys-colour-{primary,positive,negative}-main is re-pointed to the actual seed step so consumers still resolve the true brand colour (fcm.css:164-170).

manualStops.neutral: seed (#0C0D0D) sits at ramp step 900, not 500 or 1000 — the true page black is a separate step-1000 value (#000000).

typePrimitives.fontNote: One face for both roles — no COD:M-style heading/body split. No condense hack (fontCondense = 1): Cruyff Sans is a properly proportioned brand cut, unlike COD:M's static Hitmarker VF workaround.
typePrimitives.trackingNote: Plain 0.5%/1% values, no Hitmarker-style compensation needed — Cruyff Sans renders at true width.

radiusSteps.control: --x-sys-radius-full (999px, pill) — explicit override of the shared 2px system default. This is FCM's single clearest shape signature vs. every other store in the repo.

effectGlow.note: --x-hdr-glow aliases --x-ref-primary, --x-hdr-hot aliases --x-ref-secondary directly (not a mid-ramp step like COD:M) — both boost automatically under the HDR media query since they alias the ref seeds, which are boosted there.

hdr.effect: Ref seeds and surface-border alphas pushed past the sRGB ceiling on wide-gamut panels; primary green (#05E466) clips slightly in sRGB and can hold noticeably more chroma on P3.

tier2SignatureSurfaces.name: EA sign-in overlay palette
tier2SignatureSurfaces.implementation: A fully separate --x-ea-* token set (page bg, CTA blue #1473e6, input fields) scoped to [data-theme="fcm"] — an EA brand palette distinct from the FC Mobile green/yellow-green identity used everywhere else, not expressible via the shared semantic tiers.

tier2SignatureSurfaces.name: Nav-selected gradient underline + radial glow
tier2SignatureSurfaces.implementation: A literal Figma radial-gradient recipe (--x-bg-nav-selected) plus a separate gradient-stroke underline (--x-gradient-nav-selected-stroke) at 4px thickness — went through several design iterations before landing on the literal-gradient treatment per fcm.css's own changelog comment.

tier2SignatureSurfaces.name: Production SKU card gloss-metal gold/champagne surfaces
tier2SignatureSurfaces.implementation: Raw hex gloss-metal gradients (CTA gold, champagne price bar) sharing one light angle via --x-gradient-sku-card-prod-gold-angle so both surfaces stay physically consistent — predates the token system, extracted directly from a Display-P3 Figma source.

tier2SignatureSurfaces.name: Loyalty banner + checkout-footer overlap
tier2SignatureSurfaces.surface: CheckoutSheet sticky footer (FCM-only — COD:M's loyalty config is null)
tier2SignatureSurfaces.implementation: --x-checkout-loyalty-overlap (16px) and a tightened --x-shadow-checkout-footer live in the html[data-theme] (0,1,1) block specifically to beat extensions.css :root literals by specificity — a store-specific structural composition, not just a colour swap.
